####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the R2 of the best models 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")
```

# Read in the data of the models 
```{r}
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicbest.rds"))
```

# Extract R2 =======================================================================================
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")

r2_best <- sapply(str_subset(waic_best$mod_best, "multi", negate = TRUE), function(x) {
  # Read in r2
  r2 <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/modres_r2/r2_{x}"))
  # Tidy up
  bind_rows(attr(r2$r2_dec,"CI")) %>%
    mutate(
      r2 = c(r2$r2_dec$R2_Bayes, r2$r2_dec$R2_Bayes_marginal),
      r2_type = c("bayes", "bayes_marginal")) %>%
    add_row(CI = 0.95, CI_low = r2$r2_all[3], CI_high = r2$r2_all[4], r2 = r2$r2_all[1], r2_type = "all") %>%
    select(r2_type, r2, CI_low, CI_high) %>%
    rename_with(tolower)
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") 

r2_best %>%
  filter(str_detect(mod, "semeth|sebirth|seallsero", negate = TRUE),
         str_detect(mod, str_c(pat_sel, collapse = "|"))) %>%
  filter(r2_type == "bayes") %>%
  arrange(r2) %>%
  summarise(round(mean(r2),2), round(min(r2),2), round(max(r2),2))
```
